# dsm_user_quota (Resource)

Manages a user quota on a shared folder in Synology DSM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dsm_user_quota" "john_home" {
  share_name = "homes"
  username   = "john.doe"
  quota_size = 21474836480 # 20 GiB in bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `quota_size` (Number) Quota size in bytes. 0 means unlimited.
- `share_name` (String) Name of the shared folder.
- `username` (String) Username to set quota for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier: share_name:username.
- `quota_used` (Number) Current space usage in bytes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import dsm_user_quota.john_home homes:john.doe
```
